gpt-4o-mini.description: AIHubMix's paid GPT 4o Mini. Exact context/output limits and active lifecycle are published in its own model-page record on 2026-10-09. This pilot declares text generate/stream; tools, vision, strict schema and effort controls await separate evidence and acceptance. Account/model access is unverified.

errorRules.message: Invalid or expired AIHubMix API key. Check {apiKeyEnvVar} and your key permissions.
AIHubMix quota or paid-model access is insufficient. The gpt-4o-mini default is usage-priced; verify account funding and model eligibility.
The requested AIHubMix model '{model}' is retired. Select a current documented model; gpt-4o-free and gpt-5.5-free are excluded from this pilot.

instructions: 1. Sign in to the AIHubMix console and create an API key.
2. The selected gpt-4o-mini default is paid and usage-priced. Verify your own account funding, model permissions and current rates before using it.

3. The vendor-level free-tier label refers to AIHubMix's separately documented, model-limited free programme. It does not grant free usage of gpt-4o-mini; current model eligibility and allowances are unverified.
4. Current model-specific guides mark gpt-4o-free and gpt-5.5-free retired. Do not use either as a default or fallback based on older free-model marketing.
5. Set {apiKeyEnvVar} for this provider. The documented base URL is https://aihubmix.com/v1.
setup.description: AIHubMix gateway text/stream pilot with a paid gpt-4o-mini default. A separate model-limited free programme is documented; no account entitlement, roster, live inference or delivery is verified.

rosterVerified.method: Public documentation GETs of https://aihubmix.com/model/gpt-4o-mini and its /llms.txt guide. Exact own model-page record binds context_window=128000 and max_output=16384.
